page: Vultr vx1-g-48c-192g-2880s is a general-purpose server from the VX1 Cloud Compute family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz, built on the x86_64 architecture with 24 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as a 2880 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. No GPU hardware is present.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in several areas. The single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities rank in the top 10% according to stress-ng and Geekbench tests, supported by strong memory write bandwidth for large blocks. Cryptographic and vector instruction sets, including AVX-512 and SHA-ni, contribute to strong performance in extended instruction tests and encryption. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth and PassMark memory scores sit in the average tier, showing a slight tradeoff compared to the highly rated write performance.

This hardware profile offers high resource density, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for multi-threaded workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. Strong database operations, high Redis SET throughput, and top-tier text and image processing benchmarks make this server well-suited for relational databases, static web serving, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM text generation.
